title: DECISION: Test-only loopback bypass via atomic flag with cfg gating
description: ALLOW_LOOPBACK_FOR_TESTS (peer_fetch.rs:38-40) is a std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool that only compiles in #[cfg(any(test, feature = "test-utils"))]. Integration tests set it explicitly before running (peer_attachment_fetch.rs:162). Cannot be triggered by default production builds. Security-aware test design: integration tests need 127.0.0.1 access, but the bypass is sandboxed to test-only code paths.
